newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares trim losses on late buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares trim losses on late buying.

text.p: Delhi shares closed lower on heavy selling by foreign institutional investors (FIIs), but late buying by speculators trimmed early losses, brokers said on Friday.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 1.15 points lower at 646.80 after touching the day's low of 640.51.

"In view of the approaching end of the calendar year and the winter break, FIIs and other major players prefferred to keep their commitments restricted at this juncture," said Ashok Arya of brokers S.C. Gupta and Co.
Oriental Bank of Commerce was 0.70 rupee down at 72.30.
